title: Page 6
lines: 照片，年龄，简介，在他面前排开——
人选一：台湾凯基电通公司总裁千金，十八岁，独生女，是父母的掌上明珠。打小上的是国际学校，英日语皆通——
鹅蛋脸，浓眉大眼，天生的美人胚子，细皮嫩肉一身的娇气。
人选二：十八岁，台湾人。父亲是和日本人做生意的小贸易商，母亲是平凡的家庭主妇，一家人常常日本台湾两地跑，十几年来，每年都有约莫三个月的时间一家人是住在日本，所以日文还算流利——
瓜子脸，眼睛不大却有神，照片中的她笑得明亮而淘气，闪闪动人。
白胡子老人看着他，抚须徐徐说道：“这是最适合的两位，年龄相近，纯华人，日语都可以沟通，老爷子选中的是第一位，对方财力雄厚也很美丽——”
“太娇，不好伺候，也吃不了苦。”他淡淡地打断他。
抚须的手一顿，点头。“这倒是……”
“我选这位。”他指着第二位的照片。“天真阳光，相信是一个善良且懂得付出真心的好女孩，而且家庭单纯，比较好搞定。”
老人笑着频频点头。“果真是大少爷，判断快狠准。”
“请告知父亲，就决定是她了吧。”
“是，大少爷。”老人的神情，微微带着笑。“我会备好一切，等待少爷尽快归来。”
“嗯。”他轻轻点了下头，又看了照片中的女孩一眼，这才头也不回地转身走出祠堂。
祠堂外的阳光，异常刺眼。
盛夏了……
他所剩的时间并不多……
高级的音响喇叭，华丽的舞台，四处缀饰着鲜花彩带，衣香花香酒香女人香，今夜S大的学生活动中心呈现出非常不同的氛围。
大一的新生迎新舞会，是S大的盛事，也是舞冬末人生很难得的一件大事，为了盛装出席，她花了很多的私房钱去为自己添置一件漂亮的薄纱紫色绣花小礼服，和一个桃红色的迷你宴会包，微蓬的短裙可以衬托她修长美丽的腿和纤细的腰身，细肩带的设计可以彰显她迷人的颈部曲线和浑圆好看的双肩。
她不是顶尖的美人，仅仅只是清秀而已，可她身材比一般女孩高些，纤细又均匀有致，乌黑的长发很飘逸，所以不管怎么看都还是温柔可人的美人一枚——如果她乖乖站在那里微笑的话。
那是如果。
如果通常代表有变数发生，譬如，当她看见某位女同学在黑黑暗暗的舞池中，遇到硬要亲她抱她摸她的色狼时——
舞冬末皱眉再皱眉，握着香槟酒杯的指尖微微使力。她真的很不愿意在这美好的夜晚多管闲事，今天她是抱着可以等到一个白马王子请她跳舞的心情而来，否则她何必特别花钱来买身上这件美丽的小礼服？
可是，看到那只咸猪手在那位女同学的身上摸来摸去，那女同学急得快哭出来却不敢叫出声的模样，她就真的很不爽。
那男人以为他是来到酒店吗？该死的家伙！
想着，舞冬末的脚步已往前方目标移动，她的唇边带着笑，走路的姿态也算是优雅，所以当她走近那个男人时，对方是完全没有危机意识的……
直到她手上的那杯香槟酒准确无误地泼到那人的脸上，淋得他一身——
“啊！”被欺负的那只柔弱小白兔此刻惊慌失色地叫出了声，对眼前所发生的一切感到错愕又惊吓不已。
男人狼狈地伸手抹脸，挑眉，大吼出声。“你这个女人是哪里有病啊？竟拿酒泼在我脸上？”
现在本是慢舞时间，音乐声不算太大，经这男人一吼，众人的目光全都移了过来。
“谁叫你对一个柔弱的女同学硬要摸硬要抱的？没看见人家不愿意吗？看你虚长我们几岁，为什么不懂得什么叫尊重？什么叫礼貌？”舞冬末义正辞严地一字一句对着那男人说。
这里可是大学的迎新舞会，又不是可以随便闹事乱来的酒店，她就不信这男人敢公然在这里对她一个女生怎样！
男人没好气地眯起眼。“你会不会太多管闲事了？见鬼的！你这女人哪来的？什么系的？”
“你管我什么系的？一个大男人这样公然欺负女生像话吗？是个男人就该下跪认错！”舞冬末的腰杆子挺得笔直，完全不打算示弱。
就算这个高大威武的男人，此刻正一脸凶恶地挑着眉瞪她，一副想要把她掐死的样子。
“那个……”有只小手在拉舞冬末的礼服裙摆。
舞冬末侧脸看了那柔弱又害怕的女生一眼，对她微微一笑。“不要怕，我在帮你出气呢，如果他不下跪认错，我就拎他去警察局。”
说完，又转过去瞪向那个高大威武，却气得快翻白眼的男人。
“喂，女人，你真的很搞不清楚状况，我跟她是你情我愿——”
“你真够不要脸的你！她都快被你欺负到哭了，你还说你情我愿？你当别人都是瞎子吗？”真够让人生气的，众目睽睽之下，这男人还可以睁眼说瞎话？
“那个……”那只小手再次拉拉舞冬末的裙摆，只不过这回拉得比方才再用力那么一点点。“这位同学……我真的没关系……”
“什么没关系？他这种行为跟色狼无异！这里是大学校园，怎么可以视而不见助长歪风？”舞冬末再次义正辞严地说道，还握了握那位小白兔的手。“你放心，不要害怕，这里人这么多，难道他会吃了我？”
“不是的……我真的很谢谢你这么担心我……可是我……”
“说了你别怕，这里这么多人，我就不相信他还敢欺负你！”舞冬末看对方一副凶神恶煞样，越想又越气，连腰都叉起来了。
小白兔怯生生地说：“他是我男朋友……”
“什么？”舞冬末愣住了，傻傻地转头看着眼前的小白兔，觉得一股冷意从脚底一直窜上来。
有人终于忍不住笑出了声。
声音近到就在她的脑后似的。
不过她现在根本没空管是谁在笑她，或者说，现在应该所有人都在笑她吧？因为这真的很可笑。
有没有这么糗啊？她竟然在新生舞会上搞了这么一个大乌龙？义正辞严地指着人家的男朋友说是色狼还不够，还要人家下跪认错，说要把人拎到警察局？
“可是你明明一副快哭出来的样子……”舞冬末的脑袋在发晕。
“我只是不习惯他在大庭广众之下这样摸我……”小白兔吐吐舌，害怕地看了男朋友一眼，他正一脸铁青地看着她。“他很凶的，所以我不敢说不……”
又一声笑从她脑后传了过来。
真是够了……
舞冬末咬唇再咬唇，看着那位高大威武的男人，很快弯身道了歉。“对不起，这位学长，是我……误会了，真的很抱歉。”
她舞冬末能屈能伸，这点倒是她很引以为傲的。
“学长？刚刚不是还叫我色狼？”男人气呼呼地转身不知从哪取来一杯酒，想也不想便往她脸上身上泼去——
舞冬末倒抽了一口冷气，感觉冰冰凉凉的液体透过薄纱渗进内衣里。
“你以为道歉就了事啦？给本大爷跪下！你这个臭女人害我丢这么大的脸，不下跪认错，你以为我会放过你？你这个搞不清楚状况的女人！你知道本大爷是谁吗？竟然把本大爷当色狼？你该死的给我过来！”
男人的粗手一伸，一把便把舞冬末给扯过来甩在地上，力道之大让她的头磕到一旁的石柱，痛得她眼冒金星。
content_en:
Photos, ages, profiles, all lined up in front of him——
Candidate 1: Qianjin, the president of Taiwan Kaiji Dentsu Company, is an eighteen-year-old only daughter who is the apple of her parents' eye. I went to an international school when I was in elementary school, and I can speak both English and Japanese——
Oval face, thick eyebrows and big eyes, a natural beauty, delicate skin and tender flesh.
Candidate 2: 18 years old, Taiwanese. My father is a small trader doing business with the Japanese, and my mother is an ordinary housewife. The family often travels between Japan and Taiwan. For more than ten years, the family has lived in Japan for about three months every year, so I am fairly fluent in Japanese——
She has a face with oval seeds and small but lively eyes. In the photo, she smiles brightly, mischievously and dazzlingly.
The old man with a white beard looked at him, stroked his beard and said slowly: "These are the two most suitable people. They are similar in age, they are pure Chinese, and they can communicate in Japanese. The old man chose the first one. The other person is rich and beautiful -"
"Too delicate, difficult to take care of, and unable to bear hardships." He interrupted him calmly.
The hand stroking his beard paused and he nodded. "That's true..."
"I choose this one." He pointed to the photo of the second place winner. "Innocent and sunny, I believe she is a good girl who is kind and knows how to give her sincerity. She also has a simple family and is relatively easy to handle."
The old man smiled and nodded frequently. "It's true that the eldest young master is quick and ruthless in his judgment."
"Please tell father and let's decide it's her."
"Yes, young master." The old man's expression was slightly smiling. "I will prepare everything and wait for the young master to return as soon as possible."
"Yes." He nodded slightly, glanced at the girl in the photo again, and then turned around and walked out of the ancestral hall without looking back.
The sunlight outside the ancestral hall was extremely dazzling.
It's midsummer...
He doesn't have much time left...
Chapter 1(1)
High-end speakers, a gorgeous stage, decorated with flowers and ribbons everywhere, the fragrance of clothes, flowers, wine and women, the Student Activity Center of S University presented a very different atmosphere tonight.
The freshman's welcome dance was a grand event in S University and a rare event in Wu's life in late winter. In order to dress up, she spent a lot of her own money to buy herself a beautiful tulle purple embroidered dress and a pink mini party bag. The slightly puffy skirt can set off her slender and beautiful legs and slender waist, and the spaghetti strap design can highlight her charming neck curve and round and beautiful shoulders.
She is not a top beauty, she is just pretty, but her figure is taller than the average girl, slender and well-proportioned, and her long black hair is very flowing, so no matter how you look at it, she is still a gentle and lovely beauty - if she just stands there and smiles.
That's if.
If it usually means that something unexpected has happened, for example, when she saw a female classmate on the dark dance floor, she met a pervert who insisted on kissing her, holding her and touching her——
Wu Dongmo frowned again, holding the champagne glass with her fingertips slightly. She really didn't want to meddle in this beautiful night. Today she came with the mood that she could wait until a prince charming asked her to dance. Otherwise, why would she spend money to buy this beautiful little dress?
However, she was really unhappy when she saw that naughty hand touching the female classmate's body, and the female classmate looked so anxious that she was about to cry but did not dare to cry out.
Did the man think he was coming to a hotel? Damn guy!
Thinking about it, Wu Dongmo's footsteps had moved towards the target ahead. There was a smile on her lips and her walking posture was considered elegant. So when she approached the man, he had no sense of crisis at all...
Until the glass of champagne in her hand accurately splashed onto the man's face, drenching him all over——
"Ah!" The weak little white rabbit who was bullied cried out in panic at this moment, feeling shocked and frightened by what was happening in front of him.
The man stretched out his hand to wipe his face in embarrassment, raised his eyebrows, and yelled. "What's wrong with you, a woman? You threw wine in my face?"
It was slow dance time now, and the music was not too loud. After this man roared, everyone's eyes moved over.
"Who told you to insist on touching and hugging a weak female classmate? Didn't you see that she wasn't willing? Look at how much older you are than us, why don't you understand what respect is? What is politeness?" Wu Dongmo said to the man righteously every word.
This was the university's freshman dance, and it wasn't a hotel where people could cause trouble and mess around. She didn't believe that this man dared to openly treat a girl like her here!
The man narrowed his eyes angrily. "Are you being too nosy? Damn it! Where did you get this woman from? What kind of education do you have?"
"What major do you care about me? Is it okay for a grown man to openly bully a girl like this? As a man, he should kneel down and admit his mistake!" Wu Dongmo's waist was straight, and he had no intention of showing any weakness.
Even this tall and mighty man was glaring at her with a raised eyebrow in a ferocious manner, as if he wanted to strangle her to death.
"That..." A small hand was pulling the hem of the late winter dress.
Wu Dongmo glanced sideways at the weak and frightened girl and smiled at her. "Don't be afraid, I'm helping you vent your anger. If he doesn't kneel down and admit his mistake, I will take him to the police station."
After saying that, he turned around and stared at the tall and mighty man, but he was so angry that he almost rolled his eyes.
"Hey, woman, you really don't understand the situation. She and I are in love—"
"You are so shameless! She was almost bullied by you until she cried, and you still said you were in love with me? Do you think everyone else is blind?" It's really irritating. In front of everyone, how can this man open his eyes and tell lies?
"Um..." The little hand pulled Wu Dongmo's skirt again, but this time the pull was a little harder than before. "This classmate...it really doesn't matter to me..."
"What doesn't matter? His behavior is no different from that of a pervert! This is a university campus, how can you turn a blind eye and encourage unhealthy trends?" Wu Dongmo said righteously again, and shook the hand of the little white rabbit. "Don't worry, don't be afraid. There are so many people here, could he eat me?"
"No...I really appreciate you worrying about me so much...but I..."
"I told you not to be afraid. There are so many people here, and I don't believe he dares to bully you!" Wu Dongmo looked at the other party with a fierce look on his face. The more he thought about it, the angrier he became, and he even crossed his arms.
The little white rabbit timidly said: "He is my boyfriend..."
"What?" Wu Dongmo was stunned. She turned her head stupidly and looked at the little white rabbit in front of her, feeling a coldness running up from the soles of her feet.
Someone finally couldn't help laughing.
The voice was so close that it seemed like it was right behind her head.
But she has no time to care who is laughing at her now, or should everyone be laughing at her now, right? Because this is really ridiculous.
Is it so embarrassing? She actually made such a big mistake at the freshman dance? It's not enough to just point at someone's boyfriend and call him a pervert, but you also want him to kneel down and admit his mistake, and say he's going to be taken to the police station?
"But you clearly look like you're about to cry..." Wu Dongmo's head was spinning.
"I'm just not used to him touching me like this in public..." Little White Rabbit stuck out her tongue and glanced at her boyfriend in fear. He was looking at her with a livid face. "He is very fierce, so I dare not say no..."
Another laugh came from behind her head.
That's enough...
Wu Dongmo bit her lip again, looked at the tall and mighty man, and quickly bent down to apologize. "I'm sorry, senior, I... misunderstood. I'm really sorry."
She is very proud of her ability to bend and stretch when dancing.
"Senior? Didn't you just call me a pervert?" The man angrily turned around and fetched a glass of wine from nowhere, and threw it on her face without thinking -
Wu Dongmo gasped, feeling the cold liquid seep into her underwear through the gauze.
"You think apologizing is enough? Kneel down for me! You, a stinky woman, have caused me such embarrassment. If you don't kneel down and admit your mistake, do you think I will let you go? You woman who doesn't understand the situation! Do you know who I am? You actually treat me as a pervert? You damn come here!"
The man's thick hand stretched out and pulled Wu Dongmo over and threw her to the ground. The force was so strong that her head hit the stone pillar aside, and the pain made her see stars.
